title: Passage 12
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: If you love reading books, you must know about The Little Prince.
sentences.cn: 如果你喜欢读书，你一定知道《小王子》。

sentences.en: It's a famous novel written by a French writer.
sentences.cn: 这是由一位法国作家写的一本著名小说。

sentences.en: As one of the best-selling books in history,
sentences.cn: 作为历史上最畅销的图书之一，它已被翻译成253种语言和方言，销量多达2亿册。

sentences.en: it has been sold as many as 200 million copies in 253 languages and dialects.
sentences.cn: 作为历史上最畅销的图书之一，它已被翻译成253种语言和方言，销量多达2亿册。

sentences.en: Around 70 years after the birth of the book,
sentences.cn: 在这本书问世大约70年后，一位美国导演找到了一种方法，将其制作成3D动画电影。

sentences.en: an American director has found a way to make it into a 3D animated film.
sentences.cn: 在这本书问世大约70年后，一位美国导演找到了一种方法，将其制作成3D动画电影。

sentences.en: The book tells the story of a pilot, called The Aviator, who crashes in a desert, rather than an airport.
sentences.cn: 这本书讲述了一位飞行员的故事，他被称为“飞行员”，坠机在沙漠中，而非机场。

sentences.en: In the film, the story starts years after the crash, when The Aviator is much older.
sentences.cn: 在电影中，故事开始于坠机的多年后，此时的“飞行员”已经老去。

sentences.en: He has got a new neighbour called The Little Girl.
sentences.cn: 他有了一个叫“小女孩”的新邻居。

sentences.en: He tells The Little Girl about his time in the desert.
sentences.cn: 他向“小女孩”讲述了自己在沙漠中的时光。

sentences.en: His story takes her to an amazing world.
sentences.cn: 他的故事带她进入了一个奇妙的世界。

sentences.en: China is the first country in the world to see the film in two versions, in Chinese and English.
sentences.cn: 中国是世界上第一个看到这部电影中英两种版本的国家。

sentences.en: The film tells The Little Prince's story in a beautiful way.
sentences.cn: 影片以一种优美的方式讲述了小王子的故事。

sentences.en: Film tickets were quickly sold out in many cinemas and local theatres across the country.
sentences.cn: 电影票在全国许多电影院和地方剧院迅速售罄。

sentences.en: The film has received a prize,
sentences.cn: 这部电影获了奖，因为它就像一个童年梦想，在这个压力过大的社会中，大多数成年人都失去了这个梦想。

sentences.en: for it is like a childhood dream,
sentences.cn: 这部电影获了奖，因为它就像一个童年梦想，在这个压力过大的社会中，大多数成年人都失去了这个梦想。

sentences.en: which is lost by most adults in this stressed-out society.
sentences.cn: 这部电影获了奖，因为它就像一个童年梦想，在这个压力过大的社会中，大多数成年人都失去了这个梦想。

sentences.en: The radio stations also did interviews with the voice actors and actresses who addressed their thankfulness.
sentences.cn: 广播电台也对配音的男女演员们进行了采访，演员们表达了感激之情。

sentences.en: And the most touching part is that every adult was a good-natured kid like The Little Prince.
sentences.cn: 最动人的部分在于，每个成年人都曾是像小王子那样善良的孩子。

sentences.en: And it's a pity that this good characteristic goes away, as time flies.
sentences.cn: 但遗憾的是，随着时间的流逝，这种美好的特质逐渐消失。
